name: software-as-a-graph
description: A shared graph representation of your software and its dependencies that you can view, edit and agree on with your coding agent.

scripts.extract:sample: DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer xcrun swift run --package-path packages/extractor-swift saag-swift extract --path examples/ios-auth-sample/Sources --project 'AuthSample' --output examples/ios-auth-sample/.saag/graph.json
scripts.test: npm run test:extractor && npm run test:sample && npm run test:canvas && npm run test:mcp
